title: What the Potion Touches
tagline: references, and why your heal did nothing
hints: `int& hp` in the parameter list means hp IS the caller's variable, not a copy of it. Drop the `&` and every change you make evaporates at the closing brace.
`brokenHeal` is meant to be useless - write it taking `int hp` (no ampersand), add to it, and watch nothing happen. That is the lesson, not a bug.
`heal` must not overshoot: add the amount, then `if (hp > maxHp) hp = maxHp;`
`wound` must not go below zero: subtract, then `if (hp < 0) hp = 0;`
`tryBuy` does two things - it changes gold AND answers yes or no. Only subtract when the purchase actually succeeds, then `return true;`.
